## Goal
The owner gets paged for failed calls, slow tools, DLQ messages and 5xx bursts, and can trace one call end to end.

## Owns
- `infra/cdk/lib/observability-stack.ts`
- `docs/runbooks/alarms.md`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- CDK assertions: alarms exist for tool p95 > 300 ms, failed calls > 2/10 min, DLQ depth > 0, API 5xx.

## Steps
- Dashboard: calls, failures, tool latency per route, FIFO age, AgentCore errors, minutes by tenant.
- Alarm topic subscription by email (no SMS in MVP).

## Acceptance
- An induced tool error in dev fires the alarm email.

## Run
`pnpm vitest run infra/cdk/test` and `make test` before opening the PR.
